items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: And Basso and all them for the, and Ashil Bakay, he was a nice clarinet player, the white band.

ctx.x: Did you hear his uncles and his father play? No, I never heard Papai and them, I never heard them.
And Basso and all them for the, and Ashil Bakay, he was a nice clarinet player, the white band.
I knew his brother, heard him on saxophone, George, in Philadelphia.
